clue.text: For enjoyment read some lines in bed

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other, the lines going into the bed

parts.note: taken as written
rows are lines, as of print or seats

explanation.surface: Someone reading a few lines in bed before sleep, purely for pleasure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For enjoyment read' is the definition, not a description of the reading in bed.
explanation.definitionFit: To browse a book is to read through it casually, at leisure rather than for study.

clue.text: Drop of moisture round bearing is not good

indicators.note: round says the first piece goes around the second, enclosing it

parts.note: bad means not good
E is east, a compass bearing

explanation.surface: A droplet forming around a mechanical bearing is bad news for the machine.
explanation.walkthrough: A compass point counts as a 'bearing' in crosswords, so E sits inside BAD.
explanation.definitionFit: A bead of sweat or dew is a small rounded drop of liquid.

clue.text: Some ricochets in the line of darts

indicators.note: some says only part of the following word is wanted, here a run of its inner letters

explanation.surface: Darts bouncing off the board and back towards where the thrower stands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' signals a run of letters inside 'ricochets'.
explanation.definitionFit: In pub darts the oche is the marked line behind which the thrower must stand.

clue.text: Sally out to lead transport studies

indicators.note: to lead says the scrambled name comes in front of the next piece
out suggests the letters of the name are put out of order

parts.note: a bus is a form of transport

explanation.surface: Sally leaving the house to head up a project on transport.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sally out' looks like a sortie or outing, but 'out' only signals a rearrangement of the name.
explanation.definitionFit: A syllabus is the outline of the subjects covered on a course of study.

clue.text: Ponder at length on how long you may live

definitions.meaning: to ... on a matter is to keep thinking about it
to ... somewhere is to reside or live there

explanation.surface: Someone brooding over their own life expectancy.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is read loosely: where you live, rather than for how long.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb covers both lingering in thought over something and residing in a place.

clue.text: Going off, chased by police

parts.note: ran, as in ran after or pursued
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department of the British police

explanation.surface: A suspect making a run for it with the police in pursuit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Going off' is food spoiling, not a person leaving.
explanation.definitionFit: Butter or meat that is going off has turned sour and rank.

clue.text: Former student in manual work

indicators.note: work, as a verb, says the letters of the word are worked into a new shape

explanation.surface: A graduate now doing hands-on manual labour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'work' looks like part of 'manual work' but is the signal to rearrange MANUAL.
explanation.definitionFit: An alumna is a woman who has graduated from or attended a particular school or college.

clue.text: Gathering it's the custom

definitions.meaning: a large formal meeting of people, such as a party conference
an accepted way of doing things, a social norm

explanation.surface: Someone noting that holding an assembly is a long tradition.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a large assembly of people and an established practice.

clue.text: They may take an interest in banking

definitions.text: They may take an interest in banking

parts.words: They may take an interest in banking
parts.note: people keen on finance, or customers who put money in an account and earn interest on it

explanation.walkthrough: 'take an interest' reads as being curious, but means earning interest on savings.
explanation.definitionFit: Savers who put money in a bank account receive interest on it.

clue.text: Heroic Greek units holding an elevated position

indicators.note: holding says the first piece contains the second

parts.note: aces are ones, single units, as on dice or cards
a hill is a raised piece of ground

explanation.surface: Greek soldiers occupying the high ground in battle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'units' gives ACES, the ones in a pack of cards.
explanation.definitionFit: Achilles is the great warrior of the Iliad, the champion of the Greeks at Troy.

clue.text: The root that shows us pi?

parts.note: the vegetable's name, split into two words, is an instruction to turn the letters IP round, which shows us the clue's pi

explanation.surface: A mathematician asking which square root reveals the number pi.
explanation.walkthrough: 'root' suggests a mathematical root beside pi; it is a root vegetable whose name, split, tells you to turn IP round into PI.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a root vegetable, its swollen edible taproot grown as food.

clue.text: Undermine brat with a look

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous child
an air is a manner or appearance, as in an air of confidence

explanation.surface: A spoilt child undermining authority with one withering glance.
explanation.definitionFit: To impair something is to weaken or damage it, as undermining does.

clue.text: Etiquette observed by the board

parts.note: the board sounds like a company's directors, but is a dining board, a table where food is served

explanation.walkthrough: 'the board' is an old word for a dining table, as in bed and board.
explanation.definitionFit: Polite conduct while eating at the dining table, such as not talking with your mouth full.

clue.text: I'm reflecting on educational finance for expats

indicators.note: on, in a down clue, says the first piece sits above the next
reflecting says the word is set beside its own mirror image

parts.note: the word is written followed by its reflection, giving letters that read the same both ways
grants are sums given to fund a student's education

explanation.surface: Someone musing on study grants for people living abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reflecting' gives IM followed by its mirror image MI, placed 'on' GRANTS.
explanation.definitionFit: Expats seen from their new country are incomers, people settled there from abroad.

clue.text: One whose existence depends on dripping

definitions.text: One whose existence depends on dripping

parts.words: One whose existence depends on dripping
parts.note: dripping suggests fat from roasting meat, but here it is water dripping from a cave roof

explanation.walkthrough: 'dripping' tempts towards the cooking fat; the water's dripping deposits the mineral that forms it.
explanation.definitionFit: Hanging cave formations grow as mineral-laden water drips from the roof and leaves deposits.

clue.text: Old man showing a lot of bottle

definitions.meaning: the biblical patriarch said to have lived 969 years, a byword for great age
a very large wine bottle holding eight standard bottles

explanation.surface: An elderly man displaying plenty of courage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bottle' is British slang for courage, but here it is a literal large bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: The name is both the long-lived figure of Genesis and a giant champagne bottle size.

clue.text: Made a resounding comeback

parts.note: sounds like a triumphant return, but describes sound bouncing back off a surface

explanation.walkthrough: 'resounding comeback' reads as a sporting triumph, but is a sound that comes back.
explanation.definitionFit: A sound that reverberated and returned off a cliff or wall did exactly this.

clue.text: Nip or nipper

definitions.meaning: a nip is a small drink of spirits
a nipper is British slang for a small child

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a small measure of whisky and a little child.

clue.text: Novel album by Michael Jackson

definitions.meaning: a suspenseful book, such as a crime or spy story
his 1982 record, the best-selling album ever made

explanation.surface: Calling a Michael Jackson record new and original.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Novel' looks like an adjective meaning new, but is the noun for a book.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a gripping suspense book and also Jackson's famous 1982 album.

clue.text: I shall be briefly unwell

indicators.note: briefly says the phrase is shortened, as in the contracted form used in speech

parts.note: the two words run together, before they are contracted

explanation.surface: Someone predicting they will soon fall sick.
explanation.walkthrough: 'briefly' contracts I SHALL to I'LL, dropping SHA; the apostrophe is ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: Sick and unwell are simple synonyms for being in poor health.

clue.text: One who enters the services

parts.note: suggests someone joining the armed forces, but means a person attending acts of worship

explanation.walkthrough: 'the services' suggests the armed forces; here they are religious services.
explanation.definitionFit: A regular worshipper attends the services held at a place of worship.

clue.text: Twice jump a little way for a man on board

parts.note: bis is Latin for twice, used in music to mean repeat
a hop is a short jump

explanation.surface: Someone hopping twice to reach a person aboard a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' suggests a ship, but means a chessboard, where this is one of the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: The chess piece that moves diagonally is one of the men on the board.

clue.text: Criminals' joint business in trouble when in this

definitions.text: business in trouble when in this

parts.note: receivers are criminals who handle stolen goods
the hip is a joint of the body

explanation.surface: A shady joint run by crooks, a business heading for trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'joint' suggests a criminals' hangout, but is the body's hip.
explanation.definitionFit: A failing company is put under the control of an official appointed to manage its affairs.

clue.text: Sand possibly holds uranium in Arab country

indicators.note: holds says the rearranged word contains the next piece
possibly suggests the letters could be arranged another way

parts.note: U is the chemical symbol for uranium

explanation.surface: Desert sand perhaps containing uranium deposits in an Arab land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges SAND into SDAN, which 'holds' U.
explanation.definitionFit: This north-east African nation is a member of the Arab League.

clue.text: Girl upset a clergyman

indicators.note: upset, in a down clue, says the letters are turned upside down, reading from bottom to top

parts.note: Rev is short for Reverend, a clergyman's title

explanation.surface: A young woman who has offended a vicar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns A REV round to give the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's first name, as worn by the singer Lynn, so any girl so named fits.

clue.text: Talking bird many may climb up to see

indicators.note: climb up, in a down clue, says the letters are read from bottom to top
to see says the answer is to be spotted inside the words

explanation.surface: Plenty of people might climb a tree to watch a bird that talks.
explanation.walkthrough: Inside 'many may', read backwards ('climb up'), the bird appears.
explanation.definitionFit: This starling relative is known, like a parrot, for mimicking human speech.

clue.text: Sounds of stable hinges breaking

indicators.note: breaking says the word's letters are broken up and reassembled

explanation.surface: The creak of a stable door's hinges as they give way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sounds of stable' reads as creaking, but means the horses inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Horses in a stable make whinnying calls, the noise a horse makes.

clue.text: Audrey in trouble, embracing naval officer in extramarital affair

indicators.note: embracing says the rearranged name wraps around the next piece
in trouble says the name's letters are in disarray

parts.note: Lt is the abbreviation for lieutenant, a naval officer

explanation.surface: Audrey is in trouble after being caught in the arms of a sailor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in trouble' rearranges AUDREY into ADUERY, 'embracing' LT.
explanation.definitionFit: Infidelity in marriage, sex with someone other than one's spouse.

clue.text: Companion of Snow White likely to crash?

definitions.meaning: one of the seven dwarfs in the Disney film
crash is slang for falling asleep, so tired enough to drop off

explanation.surface: A worry that one of Snow White's friends might have an accident.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crash' suggests a collision, but is slang for falling asleep.
explanation.definitionFit: Drowsy, ready to nod off, and also the name of one of the seven dwarfs.

clue.text: Blissful state in which Ivan ran wild

indicators.note: wild says the letters of the words run riot into a new order

explanation.surface: Ivan in ecstasy, running about with abandon.
explanation.definitionFit: In Buddhism, the final state of perfect peace and release; loosely any state of bliss.
